title: Slime mould
description: 400 000 Physarum agents grow a network of glowing threads across dark agar toward food. The first tutorial builds the scene. A fixed-step kernel moves agents in a buffer. They sense the trail ahead, steer toward it and deposit more with atomics. Another kernel blurs and fades the trail grid. Food attracts hungry agents and feeds the network. A full-screen pass maps trail density through a tone curve and a crimson-to-gold colour ramp, with pulses and bloom. Random numbers come from @typegpu/noise. Tap to drop more food.
line: A slime mould grows glowing threads across dark agar and connects the food it finds.
